name: secure-cicd
description: AI-Based Secure CI/CD Pipeline with Risk Scoring

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.dev:ml: cd ml-engine && (.venv/bin/python src/app.py 2>/dev/null || python3 src/app.py 2>/dev/null || python src/app.py)
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:cli
scripts.test:cli: node tests/cli/smoke_engine.test.js && node tests/cli/config.test.js && node tests/cli/hooks.test.js && node tests/cli/integration.test.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
